hero.title: Supercharge Your TikTok LIVE
hero.subtitle: The ultimate toolkit for TikTok streamers. Add interactive overlays, sound alerts, text-to-speech, chatbot, and more to make your streams unforgettable.

features.title: Everything You Need to Stream Better
features.subtitle: Powerful tools designed specifically for TikTok LIVE creators

soundAlerts.title: Sound Alerts
soundAlerts.description: Automatically play custom sounds when you receive gifts, follows, or any event. Keep your audience engaged with audio feedback.

tts.title: Text-to-Speech
tts.description: Let your viewers hear their messages read aloud with customizable voices, speeds, and volumes. Make every comment matter.

overlays.title: Interactive Overlays
overlays.description: Beautiful, customizable overlays for OBS, TikTok Live Studio, and Streamlabs. Display alerts, goals, and widgets on your stream.

chatbot.title: Chatbot
chatbot.description: Automated chat responses, moderation, and custom commands. Keep your chat clean and engaging without lifting a finger.

songRequests.title: Song Requests
songRequests.description: Let your viewers request songs from Spotify. Build a playlist together and keep the vibes going all stream long.

points.title: Points System
points.description: Reward viewers for watching, chatting, and sending gifts. Let them spend points on TTS, sound effects, and special commands.

actions.title: Actions & Events
actions.description: Create custom triggers for any event. Connect to smart devices, run scripts, or control games through viewer interactions.

gameIntegration.title: Game Integration
gameIntegration.description: Let viewers control your Minecraft, GTA 5, and other games through gifts. Spawn NPCs, trigger events, and more.

step1.title: Connect Your Account
step1.description: Sign up with your TikTok account and authorize the connection. Takes less than 30 seconds.

step2.title: Configure Your Tools
step2.description: Choose your alerts, overlays, chatbot settings, and customize everything to match your brand.

step3.title: Go Live & Engage
step3.description: Add our browser sources to your streaming software and start interacting with your audience like never before.

compatibility.title: Works With Your Setup
compatibility.subtitle: Compatible with all major streaming software

pricing.title: Everything is Free
pricing.subtitle: No hidden fees, no premium plans. All features included.

about.title: About TOMAN
about.description: TOMAN is an open-source project built by streamers, for streamers. We believe every creator deserves access to professional streaming tools without paying premium prices.
about.mission: Our mission is to make TikTok streaming more interactive, fun, and engaging for creators and viewers alike.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: Everything you need to get up and running

footer.description: The ultimate toolkit for TikTok LIVE streamers. Free and open source.
